title: Stickman Arena Fighter Gameplay Devlog 1
author: Disastrous-Analyst85
selftext:
Stickman Arena fighter with Skills and ULT 

Currently set to auto parry, currently set to no Meter limit  
Attack  - possible auto attack (not set here)

Multiple Ultimate, StarCraft 2 like Shift c so multiple commands can be done on queue like teleport ult, teleport another  ult  
Tag  the enemy by hitting it with a bullet  
Clones can also do Ultimate's if have meter  
  
Have time slow so hopefully more cinematic if you have meter for it  
You can fly,  
All cost meter, even parry and teleport

Teleport as the dash (not sure if I should retain the dash
